voice_notes.transcript: okay first proper one. priya dillon, anchorage physio and rehab in bedford, four clinics, and tom, tom keddy, he runs the front desks for her. they're on book stand and the contract's up in march. priya wants a quote, per practitioner, they've got twenty two. tom wants to test drive the online booking at the bedford desk before anybody signs anything. so two different asks, two different people. she's running boston in april, wouldn't stop talking about it.

imogen krause, bluefin physio, dartmouth, two clinics, on clinic vo. her front desk spends an hour every morning on reminder calls. she wants a walk through. and she said very clearly no newsletters, no mailers, nothing, she gets forty emails a day. so just the demo, nothing else.

callum ride out, tantallon physio, one clinic, on book stand. wants a demo. but the first thing he asked was can we fill in the WCB claim forms for his injured worker patients, and honestly I don't know, I said I'd find out. so nobody promise him that until we know.

the chiro from yarmouth, nate, sir ette I think, harbour light chiropractic, the guy with the old film camera round his neck. two clinics, yarmouth and digby, on practice shift and it can't show both clinics in one calendar. wants a walk through with his associate.
kwame, clayton park physio, three clinics, book stand. their online booking keeps showing slots that are already gone and patients turn up for nothing. he wants to see a demo. good one.

bernadette from kentville, massage, one clinic, paper book and she's happy with it. she's already getting our newsletter from that webinar thing and she asked to be taken off it, too many emails. fair enough. so nothing to her.
note to self. a lot of people today asking about taking deposits for no shows, we should really have a one pager on that. and we need more coffee pods, and the banner's leaning again. okay.

alasdair gun, new glasgow, sport physio, one clinic, on clinic evo. we talked curling for ten minutes. his actual gripe is clients can't rebook from the clinivo reminder text, they have to phone in. didn't ask for anything.

tamsin, herring cove physio, one clinic, google calendar. she's just back from a hip replacement so she's only in two days a week and her associate runs things. wants a brochure she can leave for the associate. that's it.
hamid, eastern shore massage, musquodoboit harbour, paper book. his wife's expecting twins in january so nothing till february, then he wants a test drive for himself and his two RMTs.
scanner's dead, using cards. rosie from pictou, tidal touch massage, three RMTs, on book stand and she thinks it's too pricey for three people. wants to test drive it. got her card.

nadia had a french one this morning, josie or josée something, saw nyay, physio from meteghan, two clinics, on clinivo. wants prices in writing, in french. nadia's got the card and she's writing to her herself.
